name: D2 Diagrams
description: D2 code blocks, drawn by the d2 program on your computer or by a Kroki server.
author: Typora Team

backend.title: Draw with
backend.description: The d2 command runs on your computer and works offline. Kroki sends the diagram's source to a server.

command.title: Command
command.description: The d2 program, by name (looked up on your PATH) or full path. Install it from d2lang.com or with brew install d2.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Unless the diagram sets its own layout-engine.

server.title: Kroki server
server.description: A self-hosted server must also be allowed in the extension's network permission.
